description: Header file defining a template class 'Collection' for managing policy elements such as Strategy, Stream, InputSource, and Usage within the Android audio policy framework. It includes methods for adding, retrieving, finding by name, and clearing elements, and supports specific specializations for certain types.

classes.name: Collection
classes.description: Template class managing a collection of policy elements indexed by a key, supporting add, get, findByName, and clear operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new policy element to the collection with a specified name and key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a policy element by its key.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a policy element by its name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the collection and deletes them.
